roiẽt aſſeurer ſi c'eſt l'vn ou l'autre ſõt auſ
ſi faites deux ſõmaires apriſes ſur la reſẽ-
blãce de Sanxi Guerre fils de Martin, &
des ſeurs dudit Martin: auec le p̃uenu: deſ
quelles reſultẽt deux preuues trõt diffe-
rẽtes, car par la premiere eſt rapporté, q̃
Sanxi, fils de Martin, ne reſſẽble point le
preuenu, & par la ſecõde, que les ſeurs d'i-
celuy martin reſſẽblẽt fort le preuenu. La
matiere miſe en droict, par ſentẽce, led.
du Tilh priſõnier eſt cõdẽné perdre la te
ſte, & eſtre mis en iiij. quartiers. & amplié
l'arreſt à lad. de Rols. Dequoy iceluy du
Tilh, eſt apelãt en la cour du parlemẽt de
Toloſe. laq̃lle vſant de ſon accouſtumee
prouidẽce, & attẽdu l'importãce de ce ne
goce, ordõne que Pierre Cuerre oncle,
& lad de Rols viendrõt en perſonne. A-
pres ſont cõfrontez en pleine chãbre, aud
preuenu. premieremẽt la femme: où led.
du Tilh mõſtra vne cõtenãce ſi aſſeurée
& beaucoup plꝰ que ladite de Rols: telle-
ment qu'il y auoit peu de iuges aſsiſtans
qui ne ſe perſuadaſſent le priſõnier eſtre
le vray mari, & l'impoſture proceder du
coſté de la femme, & de l'õcle. toutesfois
la cour encor par là n'eſtãt ſuffiſãment in
ſtruite, ordõne qu'il ſeroit enquis d'office

spaced capitals (P A R L E M E N T  D E  T H O L O S E .), closed up per §3. Note the head spells THOLOSE while the body (blocks[0].lines[15]) spells 'Toloſe'; both transcribed as printed.

uncertain.text: quelles reſultẽt deux preuues trõt diffe-
uncertain.note: 'trõt': read letter by letter at 7x (body-2.jpg, last line, x≈1230). Glyph 1 and glyph 4 are both the roman 't' (short ascender with a left-pointing top flag and a foot that curves right), matched against the 't' of 'fort' on line 9 and against the taller, right-hooked 'f' of 'diffe-' in the same line; glyph 2 is 'r', glyph 3 is 'o' with a wavy tilde. The sense of the sentence would want 'fort' or 'tout' differentes, so this looks like a compositor's error, but nothing else is printed: transcribed as it stands (sic).

uncertain.text: des ſeurs dudit Martin: auec le p̃uenu: deſ
uncertain.note: 'p̃uenu' = preuenu: a 'p' with a tilde/macron set above the bowl (not a stroke through the descender, so not ꝑ p-with-stroke). Transcribed as p + U+0303 per §2 ('tilde over a consonant'). The mark after 'uenu' is a colon (two distinct dots at 6x), as is the one after 'Martin'.

uncertain.text: ment qu'il y auoit peu de iuges aſsiſtans
uncertain.note: ſſ vs ſs check (§7a): 'aſsiſtans' is printed long s + ROUND s ('a' + tall hooked ſ + short x-height s), checked at 8x (body-6.jpg). This is the only ſs on the page; every other double s here is a true ſſ ligature: 'aſſeurer' (line 1), 'reſſẽble' (7), 'reſſẽblẽt' (9), 'aſſeurée' (21), 'perſuadaſſent' (24) — all verified at 8x as two tall long s. 'ſuffiſãment' (27) is ſ-u-ff-i-ſ, the second s also long.

uncertain.text: preuenu. premieremẽt la femme: où led.
uncertain.note: punctuation check (§7b): the mark after 'preuenu' is a small, lightly inked ROUND dot sitting on the baseline with no descending tail (9x, body-5.jpg); read as a period, not a comma. It is faint enough that reader A may read no stop at all.

uncertain.text: coſté de la femme, & de l'õcle. toutesfois
uncertain.note: punctuation check (§7b): the mark after "l'õcle" is a round dot on the baseline with no tail at 9x (body-7.jpg), unlike the comma after 'femme' on the same line, which has a clear tail. Read as a period although the sense would prefer a comma. Printed tight ("l'õcle.toutesfois"); spacing normalized per §1.

uncertain.text: celuy martin reſſẽblẽt fort le preuenu. La
uncertain.note: the 'l' of 'reſſẽblẽt' is almost unprinted — at 8x only a broken dotted vertical trace survives between 'b' and 'ẽt'. The letter is there and the word is not in doubt. 'martin' is set with a lowercase m here (sic), unlike 'Martin' on lines 3, 4 and 7.

uncertain.text: goce, ordõne que Pierre Cuerre oncle,
uncertain.note: sic: 'Cuerre' for 'Guerre' — the capital has no crossbar at 3x, it is a C, and 'Guerre' on line 3 shows the G's bar clearly. Transcribed as printed. A justification space is printed before the comma ('goce , ordõne'); normalized away per §1.

uncertain.text: & lad de Rols viendrõt en perſonne. A-
uncertain.note: sic: 'lad' here carries NO point, checked at 8x (body-5.jpg) — compare 'lad.' with a point on line 13 and 'led.' on lines 10 and 20. Transcribed without one.

uncertain.text: pres ſont cõfrontez en pleine chãbre, aud
uncertain.note: 'en pleine' is set as one solid token ('enpleine') in the print; word division normalized to two words per §1. 'aud' (= audit) ends the line with no point and no hyphen and runs on to 'preuenu' on the next line.

uncertain.text: & beaucoup plꝰ que ladite de Rols: telle-
uncertain.note: 'plꝰ' = plus: p, l, and the raised 9-shaped -us sign, transcribed ꝰ (U+A770) per §2.

uncertain.text: Toloſe. laq̃lle vſant de ſon accouſtumee
uncertain.note: 'laq̃lle' = laquelle: q with a tilde above, transcribed q + U+0303 per §2 (verified at 7x). 'Toloſe' is sic against the running head's THOLOSE.

Tilde vs acute: every '-ent'/'-em-' contraction on this page was checked at 8-9x against a known acute ('rapporté', 'amplié', 'coſté'). The tildes are wavy, roughly horizontal strokes, the acutes clean right-leaning strokes. Read as tildes: roiẽt (1), reſẽ- (2), reſultẽt (5), rẽtes (6), reſſẽble (7), reſſẽblẽt (9), ſentẽce (10), cõdẽné (11, tilde over o AND over the first e, acute over the last), parlemẽt (14), prouidẽce and attẽdu (16), premieremẽt (20).

Spacing normalized per §1 at the many places where the compositor set punctuation or words tight or loose: space printed BEFORE a comma on lines 3 ('Martin , &'), 17 ('goce , ordõne'), 25 ('mari , &'); no space AFTER punctuation on lines 0 ('doutent,&'), 4 ('Martin:auec'), 6 ('rẽtes,car'), 22 ('Rols:telle-'), 26 ("l'õcle.toutesfois"), 28 ('ſtruite,ordõne'); words set solid on lines 1 ('aſſeurerſi'), 7 ('pointle'), 8 ('laſecõde', 'lesſeurs'), 11 ('perdrela'), 16 ("attẽdul'importãce"), 28 ("qu'ilſeroit", "enquisd'office"). No letters were changed.

uncertain.note: the line ends 'auſ' (long s, no hyphen) and line 2 opens 'ſi': the word auſ|ſi is broken across the lines without a hyphen. Likewise line 4 ends 'deſ' and line 5 opens 'quelles' (deſ|quelles), and line 11 ends 'te' with line 12 opening 'ſte' (te|ſte).
